name: 24477 · Stuarts Draft, VA
findings: ZIP 24477 (Stuarts Draft) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24477 (Stuarts Draft) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
